author: priya-raman
title: Sandbox FX totals differ by one cent between two runs
body:
## Summary

Two runs of the sandbox report for the same day differ by €0.01 in the consolidated total. The inputs are identical.

## Details

The prototype stores converted values as floats. Summing them in a different order, which the planner is free to do, gives a different last digit. This is the behaviour I warned about in the RFC review.

## Proposal

Store the rate id with the original amount and compute conversions with decimal arithmetic. Tracked in PR 163.
